title: ThresholdsResourceUsageThresholdConfig
description: The usage threshold alert configuration enables setting up alerts for when a certain usage threshold on a specific meter is crossed.

filters.description: The filters allow limiting the scope of this usage alert. You can only specify up to one filter at this time.

gte.description: The value at which this alert will trigger.

meter.description: The [Billing Meter](/api/billing/meter) ID whose usage is monitored.

recurrence.description: Defines how the alert will behave.
